# SaaS Load, Soak & Stress Test Protocol

> **Date**: [YYYY-MM-DD]
> **Duration**: [e.g., 2 hours continuous soak / 15 minutes peak stress]
> **Target System**: [e.g., API Gateway / Database Connection Pool / Background Queue]
> **Stack**: [Next.js / Node.js / FastAPI / Postgres / Redis]
> **Generated by**: `/saas-load-test` (or `/saas-load-test`)

---

## 1. Pre-Session Infrastructure Setup

Before initiating the load test:
- [ ] Staging / dedicated load environment provisioned (isolated from production tenants)
- [ ] Performance monitoring and APM active (Datadog / Prometheus / CloudWatch)
- [ ] Database connection pool limits configured:
  - Max pool size verified in `DATABASE_URL` (e.g. `connection_limit=20`)
  - PgBouncer / Prisma Accelerate pool monitor open
- [ ] Redis memory metrics and eviction policies verified
- [ ] Test dataset seeded (simulating multi-tenant volume: 1,000 workspaces, 50,000 records)
- [ ] Synthetic load tool configured: `k6`, `autocannon`, or `artillery`

---

## 2. Baseline Metrics (T+0 Idle State)

| Metric | Baseline Idle Value | Target SLA Ceiling | Alert Threshold |
|---|---|---|---|
| Server Node Memory (RSS) | [e.g. 120 MB] | < 512 MB | > 400 MB |
| CPU Utilization | [e.g. 5%] | < 70% | > 80% |
| Postgres Active Connections | [e.g. 3] | < 80% of max | > 90% |
| API p95 Latency (idle) | [e.g. 45 ms] | < 250 ms | > 500 ms |
| Error Rate (HTTP 5xx) | 0.0% | < 0.1% | > 1.0% |

---

## 3. Load Test Execution Matrix

### Scenario A: Sustained Soak (Memory Leak & Pool Exhaustion)
- **Concurrency**: 50 virtual users (VUs) continuously executing core CRUD and search routes.
- **Duration**: 2 to 4 hours.
- **Objective**: Detect memory leaks in Node/Python runtime, slow database connection leaks, and Redis cache growth.

### Scenario B: Peak Stress & Throttling
- **Concurrency**: Ramp up from 10 to 500 VUs over 5 minutes; hold peak for 10 minutes.
- **Objective**: Verify sliding-window rate limiters (HTTP 429), graceful database queuing, and auto-scaling recovery.

---

### T+[N] Minutes
- **Active VUs**: [Current concurrent users]
- **Requests Per Second (RPS)**: [Throughput]
- **API Latencies**: p50: [X ms] | p95: [Y ms] | p99: [Z ms]
- **Database Metrics**: Active connections: [N], query queue depth: [M]
- **Memory Growth**: Heap delta since baseline: [Δ MB]

## 5. Post-Test Verdict & Remediation

| Evaluation Dimension | Status | Findings & Remediation Required |
|---|---|---|
| Memory Stability (No Leaks) | [PASS / FAIL] | [Heap remained stable or unbounded growth observed] |
| Connection Pool Resilience | [PASS / FAIL] | [Zero 'too many clients' pool timeout errors] |
| Graceful 429 Rate Limiting | [PASS / FAIL] | [Rate limit headers functioned properly under burst] |
| Overall Verdict | **[PASS / CONCERNS / FAIL]** | |
